description.value: Pampanga's Cuisine is a Filipino family-owned restaurant that opened in 2018, specializing in authentic Kapampangan dishes including crispy sisig, breakfast silogs, and traditional Filipino desserts. It operates in turo-turo style — pre-cooked dishes displayed buffet-style in food warmers, reflecting the beloved carinderia street-food tradition of the Philippines — alongside an all-day breakfast menu. The restaurant expanded to a second Vancouver location in 2022 and also offers catering services for gatherings of all sizes.
